criterion.name: business_failure_evidence
criterion.description: New candidates require observed failure of a disclosed business calculation or constraint beyond floating-point boundary or formatting-only differences. This is an admission criterion independent of the unchanged primary verifier reward.
new_candidate_evidence_required: hash-bound task and actual native attempt
public business rule and affected business fields
actual value or constraint mismatch beyond numerical boundary and format-only differences
